# Aegis Health AI — Technical Product & Architecture Overview (llms.txt)

> Clinical-Grade Longitudinal Medical Intelligence & Doorstep Diagnostic Platform built on Google Cloud, Vertex AI, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Gemini 4 Argon. Official NVIDIA Inception Program Member. Registered Indian Enterprise (MSME: UDYAM-MH-33-0782403).

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Value Proposition
Aegis Health AI (`https://aegishealthai.co.in`) is an independent, AI-native healthcare intelligence platform engineered to eliminate diagnostic fragmentation for patients and clinicians in India. It bridges two critical gaps:
1. **Unstructured Pathology Extraction & Longitudinal Velocity**: Ingests multi-page diagnostic PDFs, lab reports (Thyrocare, Dr. Lal PathLabs, Metropolis, SRL/Agilus, Apollo), and handwritten clinical prescriptions, extracting quantitative biomarkers, calculating multi-year velocity, applying ICMR / South Asian cardiometabolic reference cutoffs, and generating structured SBAR (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) physician briefs.
2. **Integrated Doorstep Phlebotomy Requisition Engine (Pilot & Onboarding Phase)**: Active partner onboarding with premier NABL/CAP-accredited Indian diagnostic networks (Thyrocare Technologies, Tata 1mg Diagnostics, Redcliffe Labs, Healthians), allowing users to generate high-DPI Phlebotomy Requisition Slips for doorstep blood sample collections across 500+ Indian cities and receive automated structured results back into their longitudinal health timeline once partner fulfillment APIs are live.

## 2. Infrastructure Funding & Business Model (Why the Platform is Free to Explore)
- **100% Grant-Funded Cloud Compute**: All Google Gemini API inference, enterprise cloud hosting, and GPU compute are funded through competitive non-dilutive startup programs: **NVIDIA Inception**, **Google Cloud AI Builder**, **AWS Activate**, and **Microsoft Azure Founders Hub**. We operate with zero cloud infrastructure debt.
- **Commercial Roadmap**: Revenue is planned through standard B2B diagnostic partner referral fees upon live fulfillment, B2B OPD clinical co-pilot subscriptions for independent clinics and hospitals, and enterprise EHR integrations.
- **Zero-Data-Sale Invariant**: Under Section 12 of India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, patient medical records are strictly encrypted (AES-256), isolated per user UID in Cloud Firestore, and **NEVER sold, rented, or monetized**.
- **Open Evaluation Sandbox**: The `/dashboard` and `/demo` routes provide an open evaluation workspace with pre-loaded synthetic telemetry (`Aarav Sharma, 38M`) so clinicians, reviewers, and partners can test the complete platform with zero registration friction.

## 3. Indian Diagnostic Lab Extraction Benchmark (N = 120 De-Identified Reports)
Internal validation benchmark evaluating schema-constrained Gemini 3.8 Flash + Gemini 4 Argon escalation on analyte normalization, numeric extraction, SI-to-conventional unit conversion, and ICMR flag accuracy:
- **Thyrocare Technologies (Aarogyam PDFs, N=30)**: Precision `99.6%` | Recall `99.3%` | **F1 = `99.4%`** (Handles dense multi-column tables, CLIA/Photometry tags, nmol/L → ng/mL Vitamin D conversion).
- **Dr. Lal PathLabs (NABL Multi-Page PDFs, N=30)**: Precision `99.5%` | Recall `99.1%` | **F1 = `99.3%`** (Handles nested age/trimester brackets, footnote commentary stripping, DLC % vs absolute count).
- **Metropolis Healthcare (Clinical Panels, N=25)**: Precision `99.7%` | Recall `99.4%` | **F1 = `99.5%`** (Handles historical prior-value columns, asterisk abnormal flags, ICMR lipid risk tiers).
- **SRL Diagnostics / Agilus & Apollo (N=20)**: Precision `99.3%` | Recall `98.9%` | **F1 = `99.1%`** (Handles scanned hospital letterheads, SGPT/ALT & SGOT/AST synonym harmonization).
- **Smartphone Camera Photos + Handwritten OPD Rx (N=15)**: Precision `96.2%` | Recall `93.8%` | **F1 = `95.0%`** (Tokens `<90%` OCR confidence are automatically flagged with an amber warning badge for user confirmation).
